mapper.select: SELECT option_id AS optionId, product_id AS productId, option_name AS optionName, option_value AS optionValue FROM options WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY option_name, option_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO options(option_id, product_id, option_name, option_value) VALUES (#{optionId}, #{productId}, #{optionName}, #{optionValue})
